d:
People are lining up outside JNIMS Hospital in Manipur to get themselves tested after spurious liquor killed 16 and led to hospitalisation of nearly 600 others in Chandel and neighbouring districts.
Many arrived from neighbouring districts, particularly Chandel, fearing they may also have consumed the contaminated liquor. Although several are currently showing no symptoms, doctors are conducting medical tests and keeping them under observation to assess their condition.
